name: short-drama-novel-studio
description: 本地优先、可审片、可复现、可交付的 AI 漫剧生产工作室

scripts.db:generate: echo 'Database schema generation is owned by the new HTTP server.'
scripts.db:push: echo 'Database migrations are intentionally disabled for the fresh v3 database.'
scripts.lint: bun --bun run oxlint --deny-warnings packages apps plugins
scripts.test:unit: bun test --cwd apps/desktop/electron && bun test --cwd packages/app && bun run test:runtime && bun run test:conformance
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun scripts/run-electron-playwright.ts test
scripts.test:runtime:bun: bun test packages/ai/src/langgraph-engine.test.ts packages/ai/src/langgraph-sidecar.test.ts packages/bundles/src/index.test.ts packages/server-connection/src/index.test.ts packages/kernel/src/index.test.ts packages/database/src/cutover.test.ts packages/database/src/migration-worker.test.ts packages/desktop-host/src/agent-runtime.test.ts packages/desktop-host/src/server.test.ts packages/ui-runtime/src/index.test.ts packages/runtime/src/effective-graph.test.ts packages/runtime/src/event-runtime.test.ts packages/runtime/src/http-security.test.ts packages/runtime/src/route-registry.test.ts packages/runtime/src/providers.test.ts packages/runtime/src/workspace-writing.test.ts plugins/system/src/index.test.ts && bun packages/database/src/migration-worker.integration.ts
scripts.test:conformance: bun run test:plugin-api-conformance && bun run test:engine-conformance && bun run test:extension-host-conformance && bun run test:extension-security && bun run test:marketplace
scripts.format: bun --bun run prettier --write README.md package.json playwright.config.ts tests/electron tsconfig.base.json apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts apps/desktop/electron apps/desktop/scripts apps/desktop/tsconfig*.json packages plugins profiles scripts/check-runtime-architecture.mjs
scripts.format:check: bun --bun run prettier --check README.md package.json playwright.config.ts tests/electron tsconfig.base.json apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts apps/desktop/electron apps/desktop/scripts apps/desktop/tsconfig*.json packages plugins profiles scripts/check-runtime-architecture.mjs
